SELECT expiring, expired, low_stock, sales_count, sales_total, discount_total, open_shifts FROM (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(is_expiring), 0) AS expiring, COALESCE(SUM(is_expired), 0) AS expired FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN ("inventory_lot"."expiration_date" > '2026-11-13'::date AND "inventory_lot"."expiration_date" <= '2026-12-13'::date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_expiring", CASE WHEN "inventory_lot"."expiration_date" <= '2026-11-13'::date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_expired" FROM "inventory_lot" WHERE "inventory_lot"."available_quantity" > 0) AS lot_rows) AS lot_totals CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS low_stock FROM (SELECT "catalog_product"."id" AS "pk" FROM "catalog_product" INNER JOIN "catalog_category" ON ("catalog_product"."category_id" = "catalog_category"."id") LEFT OUTER JOIN "inventory_lot" ON ("catalog_product"."id" = "inventory_lot"."product_id") WHERE ("catalog_category"."is_active" AND "catalog_product"."is_active") GROUP BY 1, "catalog_product"."minimum_stock" HAVING COALESCE(SUM("inventory_lot"."available_quantity") FILTER (WHERE ("inventory_lot"."expiration_date" > '2026-11-13'::date)), 0) <= ("catalog_product"."minimum_stock")) AS critical_rows) AS critical_totals CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS sales_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS sales_total, COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0) AS discount_total FROM (SELECT "sales_sale"."total_amount" AS "total_amount", "sales_sale"."discount_amount" AS "discount_amount" FROM "sales_sale" WHERE ("sales_sale"."confirmed_at" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Lima')::date = '2026-11-13'::date) AS sale_rows) AS sale_totals CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_shifts FROM (SELECT "cash_cashshift"."id" AS "pk" FROM "cash_cashshift" WHERE "cash_cashshift"."status" = 'OPEN') AS shift_rows) AS shift_totals
